visualFindings.companion: Personally viewed all 24 idle frames and nine equipped techniques (12 time samples, front/side). Arm mesh remains integrated in the preview. Action poses are restrained; no thin wedge or disjointed joint observed.
visualFindings.earthStrike: The actual production PetYardModelStage loaded the exact private battle bytes. Personally viewed side-view samples at .36, .48, .60, .76 seconds: shoulder and upper arm remain massed into the torso through strike and recovery.
